about: The heat network source registry: one record per organisation in data/core/ORGANISATIONS.json, with its official domain and the pages where it publishes jobs, consultancies, tenders, grants and fellowships. Written by research/2026-11/opportunities/registry.js (keeps confirmed pages across runs); read by tools/opportunities-sweep.js, which records each check in data/funding/coverage.json. A page listed here is where to look, not a claim that anything is open.
